{{Top}}
[[File:Collecting_berries.png|thumb|250px|Young Ewoks collecting berries]]
A '''berry''' was any sort of a small, roundish and juicy [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]].

The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of diminutive [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], relied heavily on berries<ref name="GG5">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>&mdash;which they called ''sleech'' in [[Ewokese/Legends|their language]]<ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>&mdash;as a means of subsistence. Their [[Diet/Legends|diet]] included [[Grava berry|grava berries]],<ref name="GG5" /> [[Cambylictus berry|cambylictus berries]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> and the multicolored [[Rainbow berry|rainbow berries]].<ref name="BESP">''[[The Baby Ewoks' Picnic Surprise]]''</ref> Other berries included the [[Aleudrupe berry/Legends|aleudrupe berry]] of [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]],<ref name="SWAJ1">{{JournalCite|1|First Contact}}</ref> the [[clait-berry]] of [[Tazan]],<ref name="UCD">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=rpga/articles/rx20010816s|text=Ultimate Core Dump|int=Ultimate Core Dump}}</ref> the [[cloudberry]] of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]<ref name="TTB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> and the [[Juna berry]] of [[Gala]].<ref name="JA:MC">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]''</ref>
